title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Pinayag, Municipality of Kayapa, Province of Nueva Vizcaya to Be Known as Pinayag National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Pinayag, Municipality of Kayapa, Province of Nueva Vizcaya to Be Known as Pinayag National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Pinayag, Thị trấn Kayapa, Tỉnh Nueva Vizcaya được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Pinayag
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Pinayag, เทศบาล Kayapa, จังหวัด Nueva Vizcaya ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Pinayag
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Pinayag, Kotamadya Kayapa, Provinsi Nueva Vizcaya dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Pinayag
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Pinayag, Perbandaran Kayapa, Wilayah Nueva Vizcaya dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Pinayag

text.en: - There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Pinayag. Municipality of Kayapa, Province of Nueva Viscaya to be known as Pinayag National High School.

- The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Pinayag National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
- The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act within ninety (90) days after its effectivity.
- This act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in any newspaper of general circulation.
